description: Twenty new prospective EN/PL stress cases authored and frozen before any generation at compact-v5-t1024; 10 EN/10 PL. Core truth/temporal, reference/operator, scope and unsupported boundaries. Curated, not production-frequency sample. Gold uses actual unchanged executor semantics.

cases.category: Present membership; clear false proposition is valid, not past membership or clarification.
cases.question: Does the country currently belong to the Soviet Union?
cases.notes: Present membership; clear false proposition is valid, not past membership or clarification.
cases.meaning_guard: Present membership; clear false proposition is valid, not past membership or clarification.

cases.category: Polish present dissolved-organization membership, distinct from past association.
cases.question: Czy kraj ma obecnie członkostwo w Związku Radzieckim?
cases.notes: Polish present dissolved-organization membership, distinct from past association.
cases.meaning_guard: Polish present dissolved-organization membership, distinct from past association.

cases.category: Clear Boolean contradiction remains valid; preserve both opposed clauses.
cases.question: Is the country both an island and not an island?
cases.notes: Clear Boolean contradiction remains valid; preserve both opposed clauses.
cases.meaning_guard: Clear Boolean contradiction remains valid; preserve both opposed clauses.

cases.category: A false numeric proposition is valid; retain exact strict bound.
cases.question: Czy ludność kraju wynosi mniej niż zero osób?
cases.notes: A false numeric proposition is valid; retain exact strict bound.
cases.meaning_guard: A false numeric proposition is valid; retain exact strict bound.

cases.category: Named reference, inclusive population comparison; no invented literal.
cases.question: Is its population at least the population of Indonesia?
cases.notes: Named reference, inclusive population comparison; no invented literal.
cases.meaning_guard: Named reference, inclusive population comparison; no invented literal.

cases.category: Named area reference and inclusive upper comparison; numeric not-greater-than is <=.
cases.question: Czy powierzchnia kraju nie jest większa niż powierzchnia Finlandii?
cases.notes: Named area reference and inclusive upper comparison; numeric not-greater-than is <=.
cases.meaning_guard: Named area reference and inclusive upper comparison; numeric not-greater-than is <=.

cases.category: Named directional comparison; preserve compass operator and self-reference unknown.
cases.question: Is the country geographically north of Portugal?
cases.notes: Named directional comparison; preserve compass operator and self-reference unknown.
cases.meaning_guard: Named directional comparison; preserve compass operator and self-reference unknown.

cases.category: Named longitude direction; preserve compass operator and self-reference unknown.
cases.question: Czy kraj leży geograficznie na zachód od Australii?
cases.notes: Named longitude direction; preserve compass operator and self-reference unknown.
cases.meaning_guard: Named longitude direction; preserve compass operator and self-reference unknown.

cases.category: Existential neighbor with inner negation, not global not-any; country item binding.
cases.question: Does any country on its land border lack EU membership?
cases.notes: Existential neighbor with inner negation, not global not-any; country item binding.
cases.meaning_guard: Existential neighbor with inner negation, not global not-any; country item binding.

cases.category: No neighbor is a NATO member; not-any and all-not are equivalent, preserve full quantifier scope.
cases.question: Czy prawdą jest, że żaden jego sąsiad lądowy nie należy do NATO?
cases.notes: No neighbor is a NATO member; not-any and all-not are equivalent, preserve full quantifier scope.
cases.meaning_guard: No neighbor is a NATO member; not-any and all-not are equivalent, preserve full quantifier scope.

cases.category: Explicit supported Protestant category, not broad four-category Christianity.
cases.question: Is Protestant Christianity its dominant religious grouping?
cases.notes: Explicit supported Protestant category, not broad four-category Christianity.
cases.meaning_guard: Explicit supported Protestant category, not broad four-category Christianity.

cases.category: Ordinary Christianity umbrella spans all four supported Christian groupings.
cases.question: Czy kraj ma chrześcijaństwo jako przeważającą religię?
cases.notes: Ordinary Christianity umbrella spans all four supported Christian groupings.
cases.meaning_guard: Ordinary Christianity umbrella spans all four supported Christian groupings.

cases.category: Clear cultural-country association; no cultural facts, not official-language/geography proxy.
cases.question: Is it culturally a Slavic country rather than a language-status question?
cases.notes: Clear cultural-country association; no cultural facts, not official-language/geography proxy.
cases.meaning_guard: Clear cultural-country association; no cultural facts, not official-language/geography proxy.

cases.category: Language prevalence differs from legally official-language status.
cases.question: Czy dominującym językiem codziennej komunikacji jest niemiecki?
cases.notes: Language prevalence differs from legally official-language status.
cases.meaning_guard: Language prevalence differs from legally official-language status.

cases.category: Official-name spelling unsupported; never substitute common-name suffix.
cases.question: Does its official state name end with the quoted letters "ia"?
cases.notes: Official-name spelling unsupported; never substitute common-name suffix.
cases.meaning_guard: Official-name spelling unsupported; never substitute common-name suffix.

cases.category: Common English name prefix; preserve exact quoted text.
cases.question: Czy zwyczajowa angielska nazwa państwa zaczyna się dokładnym tekstem "South"?
cases.notes: Common English name prefix; preserve exact quoted text.
cases.meaning_guard: Common English name prefix; preserve exact quoted text.

cases.category: Target membership and bordering clause are separate, conjunctive and complete.
cases.question: Is it a NATO member and does it border France?
cases.notes: Target membership and bordering clause are separate, conjunctive and complete.
cases.meaning_guard: Target membership and bordering clause are separate, conjunctive and complete.

cases.category: (Republic OR island) AND no white flag color; retain narrow negation.
cases.question: Czy kraj jest republiką albo wyspą, ale nie ma białego koloru na fladze?
cases.notes: (Republic OR island) AND no white flag color; retain narrow negation.
cases.meaning_guard: (Republic OR island) AND no white flag color; retain narrow negation.

cases.category: Missing reference country and quantitative distance criterion; do not invent either.
cases.question: Is it far north of some country?
cases.notes: Missing reference country and quantitative distance criterion; do not invent either.
cases.meaning_guard: Missing reference country and quantitative distance criterion; do not invent either.

cases.category: Past membership of an active organization has no historical membership facts; do not substitute present EU membership.
cases.question: Czy ten kraj miał w przeszłości członkostwo w Unii Europejskiej?
cases.notes: Past membership of an active organization has no historical membership facts; do not substitute present EU membership.
cases.meaning_guard: Past membership of an active organization has no historical membership facts; do not substitute present EU membership.
